manuscript.title: Repeatable vertical identity in bat airspace persists after horizontal occupancy is standardized

central_claim: Across six bat tracking panels, identity-matched vertical profiles retain more held-out predictive information than expected under session-level exchangeability after self and other profiles are standardized to the same occupancy among the tested 5-km horizontal cells.
